phases.title: Contracts and executable fixtures
phases.exit_gate: Agree domain boundaries, review representative fixtures, and choose the editor architecture before downstream implementation.

phases.title: Durable data and access boundaries
phases.exit_gate: Typed models, revisioned storage, migration/recovery, provenance, and publication projections pass contract tests.

phases.title: Graph and operating services
phases.exit_gate: Reversible commands, route evaluation, pinned operating selection, and reviewed promotion work without UI coupling.

phases.title: Workbench integration and accessible editing
phases.exit_gate: Inventory, canvas/list editing, guided construction, and evidence-aware results use the same services.

phases.title: Profile and alternate graph views
phases.exit_gate: Profile composition, notebooks, extra layers, export, and rack arrangement reuse established data and permission contracts.

phases.title: Integrated verification and cutover
phases.exit_gate: Real operator validation and integrated data/access/release evidence meet the agreed gates; all S01–S17 remain accounted for.

tasks.title: Define domain contracts and representative station fixtures
tasks.goal: Record architecture decisions and executable examples before choosing or integrating a graph editor.
acceptance: Specify model/instance, device port, typed edge/cable run, setup/location, immutable revision, layout, measurement, experiment, operating selection, and published projection ownership.
Define draft versus in-use transitions including shared gear updates, delete/reference impact, historical QSO behavior, and live telemetry separation; identify all current consumers.
Fixtures cover simple HF, portable, receive-only, shared gear, switched antennas, inline accessories, unknown specs, custom/homebrew/legacy gear and unsupported branches.
Evaluate canvas library against keyboard/touch/list parity, controlled commands, layout persistence and license/bundle budget; record decision and rejected tradeoffs.

Record units, identity stability, validation outcomes, publication audiences, offline/sync conflict policy and migration recovery strategy. Track unresolved decisions as blocking issues, not implicit defaults.
tasks.verification: Review ADRs against every approved requirement; run fixture contract checks. No application cutover in this issue.

tasks.title: Implement equipment, ports and provenance contracts
tasks.goal: Provide stable physical inventory and typed endpoint/evidence records shared by all setup views.
acceptance: Separate catalog model from physical instance; stable IDs and typed port templates support RF, power, audio, control/data and documented bonding.
Support unknown/partial/custom/homebrew/legacy specifications and owned, borrowed, planned and retired lifecycle; preserve existing metadata/photos.
Preserve private serials, receipts, purchase/condition/firmware/maintenance/manual notes and Used in references without exposing them through public types.
Evidence distinguishes measured, manufacturer, user-declared, estimated and unknown, with frequency, date, point, method/source and units; hypothetical SWR is never a measurement.
tasks.verification: Round-trip fixtures, invalid/unknown units and evidence validation, stable reference tests.

tasks.title: Implement setup graph, revisions and separate layouts
tasks.goal: Create the canonical topology and immutable revisions that every editor, experiment and operating consumer can share.
acceptance: Stable setup, port and connection IDs represent cable runs and their explicit inline components, equipment references, intended routes, power/band and location.
Coordinates, grouping and view preferences live separately from electrical connectivity; list/canvas/rack use the same graph.
Draft edits cannot mutate a reviewed revision or resolved equipment inputs; revision restore creates an explicit recoverable transition.
Shared instances stay shared; cloning a setup does not silently clone physical gear. Record dangling references and unsupported topology without fabricating connections.
tasks.verification: Graph/revision immutability and layout-independence tests including shared instance, branch and duplicate fixtures.

tasks.title: Persist and migrate revisioned station data safely
tasks.goal: Make the new contracts durable through local persistence, cloud sync, migrations and recovery.
acceptance: Version serialization, local storage/IndexedDB and backend schema/RLS with owner isolation and idempotent migrations.
Migrate existing ordered chains, side accessories, metadata, measurements, layouts where available and active selection without inventing unsupported branches.
Define and test offline edits, concurrent updates, stale revisions, reference deletion, reconnect/retry and transaction failure; no silent last-write overwrite of reviewed selections.
Provide export/backup and rollback or forward-recovery rehearsal with existing owner/development records. No live users does not authorize discarding existing data.
tasks.verification: Migration golden fixtures, two-client sync/conflict tests, authorization tests and documented recovery rehearsal.

tasks.title: Enforce audience projections and media access
tasks.goal: Establish the publication boundary before richer station or profile data can be exposed.
acceptance: Define owner/friend/visitor field allowlists and enforce them server-side, including section visibility, chosen grid precision and featured setup summaries.
Audit current Friends rendering, row policies, media bucket policy, URL delivery and caches; distinguish established defects from unverified baseline observations.
Exact location, serials, receipts, purchase/private notes and raw wiring/inventory stay private by default, including nested responses, exports and thumbnails.
Test visibility changes, revoked friendship, cached responses and previously obtained image URLs against the documented access/expiry contract.
tasks.verification: Negative API/RLS/media tests for owner, friend, visitor and signed-out contexts; preserve a sanitized evidence matrix.

tasks.title: Build transactional graph commands and undo/redo
tasks.goal: Create one mutation service that canvas, list and guided setup call.
acceptance: Commands cover add, remove-from-setup, connect, reconnect, explicit-gap insertion, run-specific inline insertion, reorder, move and auto-layout.
Honor requested insertion or preview the alternative and reason before commit; never silently pick the first run.
Undo/redo restores topology and layout consistently; canceled and failed edits are atomic. Define persistence and concurrent-edit boundaries for history.
Shared inventory deletion is separate from remove-from-setup and shows affected references; expose command results sufficient for focus restoration.
tasks.verification: Command sequence/property invariants, failure/undo/redo and exact insertion fixtures; no UI-only mutation paths.

tasks.title: Compile selected RF routes into the existing engine
tasks.goal: Adapt supported graph routes to the canonical station calculation engine without treating every diagram as a valid circuit.
acceptance: Use explicit switch ports and intended selected route; flag exclusive route conflicts without claiming hardware switched.
Evaluate recorded port role, signal class, connector and relevant ratings; confirmed contradiction, compatible and unknown are distinct.
Extract supported ordered RF routes for the existing engine; preserve unsupported branches/layers as documentation and show calculation limits.
Return metric, units, provenance, missing inputs and assumptions; unknown is not zero. Keep gear capability, modeled route, measurements and path/time/conditions estimates separate.
tasks.verification: Known-route parity against the existing engine plus switch, inline, cycle/branch, unknown and unsupported layer cases.

tasks.title: Pin operating context to reviewed setup revisions
tasks.goal: Make Use in ProPulse the explicit boundary between editing and the context consumed by other app areas.
acceptance: Inspecting, opening/collapsing, duplicating, moving and editing never change operating selection, even for the setup currently in use.
Use in ProPulse reviews setup/location, route, band/power, missing inputs and affected app contexts, then pins a reviewed revision and resolved equipment inputs.
An incomplete draft cannot silently replace a working setup; mark Changes not yet in use until explicit promotion.
Shared equipment/measurement updates prompt impact review; historical log entries remain intact. Live conditions and real telemetry retain their separate freshness/source behavior.
tasks.verification: Integration tests for every operating-context consumer identified in W01, including log snapshots and edits to the in-use setup.

tasks.title: Implement isolated experiments and reviewed promotion
tasks.goal: Keep what-if overrides separate from physical inventory and make promotion explicit and reviewable.
acceptance: Persist baseline revision and selected overrides without changing inventory or selected operating inputs during preview.
Save as new setup is the default; shared updates list every affected setup and apply only explicitly selected changes.
Retain current selected-band preservation and reset behavior; changing a scenario assumption cannot create a measured SWR record.
Detect stale baselines and concurrent shared changes; require a refreshed impact review before commit and preserve prior revisions.
tasks.verification: No-write preview assertions, multi-setup impact and stale-baseline tests, selected-band and provenance regression checks.

tasks.title: Connect practical inventory to the new services
tasks.goal: Provide a useful My gear area and compact shelf without forcing catalog completeness.
acceptance: Create/search/edit custom, homebrew, legacy and catalog gear with partial specs, lifecycle, labels/photos and private metadata.
Show Used in references and distinguish remove-from-setup from inventory deletion with impact review.
Offer reuse of physical items across setups; preserve existing metadata and support unit preferences without silently changing stored meaning.
tasks.verification: Owner inventory UI checks with representative fixtures, shared-reference edits and failed/offline saves.

tasks.title: Build the station canvas and connection inspector
tasks.goal: Replace nested card/editor modes with a gear shelf, editable canvas and focused inspector.
acceptance: Show persistent Editing and Using in ProPulse states plus pending draft changes; share canonical navigation with Profile, My gear and Experiments.
Visible Connect to, Insert, From/To ports, cable selection and preview allow radio-to-antenna construction without context menus.
Selected lines reconnect/inspect; explicit gap and inline-run insertion use the command service. Moving/layout never changes topology.
Progressive RF detail shows intended switch route, incomplete documentation and compatibility outcomes; support labels/line styles beyond color.
tasks.verification: Owned isolated browser session checks for simple and switched fixtures, insertion/undo and selection invariants; screenshots.

tasks.title: Deliver full list, keyboard and touch parity
tasks.goal: Make every essential editing operation available without dragging or tiny handles.
acceptance: Connections list and canvas support add, connect, reconnect, inspect, reorder, remove and undo through shared commands.
Provide a non-drag pointer alternative as well as keyboard semantics, visible focus, touch-sized controls and sensible focus restoration after edit/cancel/undo.
Keep labels, errors and route state understandable with assistive technology, zoom and monochrome; verify accessible theme contrast.
tasks.verification: Keyboard-only and click/tap task checks, focused accessibility automation and manual screen-reader/zoom evidence.

tasks.title: Add guided construction using the same editor
tasks.goal: Make a first setup approachable without creating a second model or dead-end wizard.
acceptance: Offer simple HF, portable, receive-only and blank starts: Add radio, Add antenna, Connect, Review.
Allow unknown specs and custom gear, save incomplete drafts and make missing calculation inputs explicit.
Finish in the normal workbench with the same IDs, undo commands, revision history and connection list; no re-entry of gear.
Review before Use in ProPulse; lengths and other units follow operator preference.
tasks.verification: Fresh-account fixture flows across all starts with click/tap and keyboard; incomplete and resumed setup cases.

tasks.title: Present estimates and measured evidence honestly
tasks.goal: Expose capability and measurement context where operators inspect or compare a station.
acceptance: Label estimated metrics precisely and display band/power/route, assumptions, units, unknowns and unsupported topology limits.
Provide distinct measured entry with frequency/date/point/method/source and distinguish it from manufacturer/declaration/scenario inputs.
Do not imply a universal station score, guaranteed contact or electrical validation from diagram completeness; preserve engine warnings.
Shared measurement changes show affected setups and do not rewrite selected inputs or historical QSOs without the reviewed flow.
tasks.verification: UI/engine contract checks for known, unknown, estimated and measured cases; verify illustrative mock values are not hard-coded results.

tasks.title: Define profile modules and customization persistence
tasks.goal: Create typed, audience-aware profile content and preferences before building the composer.
acceptance: Support identity/pronunciation, chosen region/grid precision, languages, optional license and portable/club calls.
Support bands/modes, frequencies/nets, UTC/local windows, QSL/skeds and optional expiring availability.
Support station photo/story/constraints, featured setup, interests/projects/build notes, learning and mentoring offered/requested.
Keep optional computed contacts/history/awards/milestones distinct from editable biography with source/privacy preserved.
Persist module order/visibility, cover crop, accessible accent/theme/density and reset defaults; private inventory never becomes profile content implicitly.
tasks.verification: Schema/default/migration and audience-projection tests for every module and preference, including unknown/empty states.

tasks.title: Build profile composition and audience preview
tasks.goal: Let operators shape a profile around operating interests, projects and a deliberately chosen station showcase.
acceptance: Edit all W15 modules with visibility/order, featured setup, cover crop, accessible accent, light/dark and density controls.
Provide Reset layout and Preview as friend/visitor using the real projection contract; no arbitrary CSS required.
Publish only selected summaries/media, precise estimate labels and optional computed statistics; small/custom stations remain first-class.
Keep common navigation and theme behavior consistent with the workbench; avoid duplicated mockup navigation.
tasks.verification: Owner/friend/visitor browser and API checks including hidden fields/media, customization persistence and reset.

tasks.title: Add named comparison notebooks and revision recall
tasks.goal: Make experiments durable and understandable across changes to a station.
acceptance: Name alternatives with gear/route overrides and compare at a fixed stated band and input power; show exactly what changed.
Keep build notes and sourced measurements distinct from assumptions, preserving baseline provenance and dates.
Restore prior revisions without silently mutating shared physical records or operating selection; expose reviewed promotion.
tasks.verification: Saved/reopened comparisons, stale baseline, revision restore and shared-equipment regression scenarios.

tasks.title: Add optional typed station documentation layers
tasks.goal: Expand documented connections without cluttering initial RF setup or overstating simulation.
acceptance: Reveal power, audio, control/data and bonding layers with recorded typed endpoints and labels/line styles.
Ground/bonding symbols represent recorded connections, not synthesized assurances; layouts and visibility do not change topology.
Mark unsupported analysis explicitly; documentation is not a validated installation or evidence of actual energized/switched hardware.
Retain list/keyboard/touch parity and unknown compatibility handling in each layer.
tasks.verification: Multi-layer fixtures and exports to canonical graph; verify the RF engine never consumes arbitrary non-RF paths.

tasks.title: Export sanitized diagrams and connection schedules
tasks.goal: Produce useful share/print artifacts through the same audience boundary as profiles.
acceptance: Choose audience and detail explicitly; export selected diagram and connection schedule with readable monochrome labels.
Include relevant estimate labels, assumptions, measurement provenance, units and revision context.
Exclude private inventory/location/media and hidden wiring from artifact content and metadata; audience preview matches export.
Large setups paginate or scale legibly; generic/custom gear is supported.
tasks.verification: Rendered export visual QA and content/privacy checks for owner/friend/visitor variants, hidden fields and monochrome output.

tasks.title: Add an optional rack and bench arrangement view
tasks.goal: Keep the approved later physical arrangement view visible in scope and implement it on the same graph.
acceptance: Arrange existing gear on a rack/bench with separate saved layout; switching views never changes connectivity, IDs or selected route.
Generic/custom/homebrew gear works without bespoke imagery or 3D assets.
Provide accessible move/reorder controls and undo; preserve setup revision and operating-context boundaries.
Any decision to defer this deliverable requires explicit scope approval recorded on the parent and requirement register; do not close it as delivered.
tasks.verification: Cross-view graph invariants and keyboard/touch arrangement checks with custom/shared equipment.

tasks.title: Validate workflows with real operators and resolve findings
tasks.goal: Replace simulated-panel hypotheses with observed use before declaring the redesign complete.
acceptance: Recruit six consenting operators spanning station complexity, portable/home/club, modern/legacy gear and input needs; simulated personas are not participants.
Observe fresh setup, unknown gear, inspect without activation, switched route, cable comparison and private profile publication tasks.

Target at least 5/6 unaided first setups within three minutes, all distinguish editing/use, no unintended shared writes and correct audience publication; record actual results without inventing evidence.
File and link each actionable finding, retest blockers and document accepted tradeoffs. If recruitment is unavailable, keep this issue and release gate explicitly blocked.
tasks.verification: Sanitized protocol/results and linked findings with retest evidence; avoid publishing participant personal data.

tasks.title: Verify all requirements and complete the controlled cutover
tasks.goal: Close delivery only when the full dependency plan has implementation and verification evidence.
acceptance: Attach a requirement-by-requirement S01–S17 evidence matrix with merged PRs, tests, UI/export evidence and remaining scope decisions.
Rehearse owner/development data migration, two-client/offline recovery, rollback/forward recovery and audience/media boundaries on the integrated build.
Run repository-required lint/build/tests and isolated UI checks, assess bundle/performance on representative large setups, and resolve all actionable review findings.
Deploy the verified revision and smoke-test actual deployment, draft/use state, persistence, publication and exports; record URL and commit.
Retire obsolete chain/editor paths only after consumer parity. No HamClock display changes; coordinate any shared navigation/store work with its agent.
Do not close the parent or mark phases complete with unresolved criteria, missing participant validation or deferred scope lacking explicit owner approval.
tasks.verification: Release evidence comment with exact commit, commands/results, migration/recovery records, deployment smoke checks and approved exceptions if any.
